label: estimate from published average factors
scope: Material production and entered freight are separate components. A combined figure is shown only when the material factor is an exact product match and ends at the production gate, so entered freight cannot overlap it. UK DESNZ material factors include transport to the point of sale and are UK reporting averages, so they are never combined with entered freight. Excludes use, end of life, packaging, warehousing and supplier-specific data.
